accordion.title: What is Sleet Automation Logistics?
accordion.content: Sleet Automation Logistics is a logistics technology company that provides intelligent transportation solutions through four integrated services: Sleet Logistics, Sleet SaaS, Sleet TNC, and Sleet AI. Our platform helps businesses manage fleets, automate operations, and make data-driven decisions from a single dashboard.

accordion.title: What is Sleet SaaS?
accordion.content: Sleet SaaS is a cloud-based logistics management platform designed for logistics companies, transport providers, and enterprises. It enables businesses to manage fleets, drivers, customers, deliveries, and operations without developing software from scratch.

accordion.title: Who can use Sleet SaaS?
accordion.content: Sleet SaaS is ideal for Logistics Companies, Fleet Owners, Freight Forwarders, Manufacturing Companies, Retail & E-commerce Businesses, Construction Companies, Oil & Gas Companies, and Distribution & Supply Chain Businesses.

accordion.title: What is Sleet Logistics?
accordion.content: Sleet Logistics is our end-to-end fleet management solution that combines Sleet's own fleet of trucks with a powerful management dashboard. Businesses can monitor vehicles, drivers, deliveries, fuel usage, maintenance, and overall fleet performance in real time.

accordion.title: What is Sleet TNC?
accordion.content: Sleet TNC is a digital truck-booking marketplace that works similarly to ride-hailing platforms, but specifically for commercial transportation. Businesses can book trucks on demand, while fleet owners receive delivery requests through the platform.

accordion.title: How does Sleet AI work?
accordion.content: Sleet AI is your intelligent logistics assistant built directly into the Sleet dashboard. Simply type your request in natural language, and Sleet AI analyzes your operational data to generate reports, summaries, insights, and recommendations within seconds.

accordion.title: What types of reports can Sleet AI generate?
accordion.content: Sleet AI can generate reports for Fleet Performance, Driver Performance, Fuel Consumption, Delivery Status, Trip History, Vehicle Utilization, Operational KPIs, Financial Summaries, and Custom Business Reports.

accordion.title: Which file formats does Sleet AI support?
accordion.content: Sleet AI can export reports in multiple formats, including PDF, Microsoft Word (.docx), Microsoft Excel (.xlsx), CSV, Charts & Graphs, and presentation-ready summaries.

accordion.title: Can Sleet integrate with my existing systems?
accordion.content: Yes. Sleet provides secure APIs that allow integration with ERP systems, accounting software, GPS tracking devices, telematics hardware, IoT sensors, and other third-party business applications.

accordion.title: Is my business data secure?
accordion.content: Absolutely. We prioritize enterprise-grade security through encrypted data transmission, secure cloud infrastructure, role-based access control, regular backups, and industry best practices to keep your data protected.

accordion.title: Can I monitor my fleet in real time?
accordion.content: Yes. Sleet provides live vehicle tracking, trip monitoring, driver activity, route visibility, fuel analytics, and operational insights through a centralized dashboard accessible from anywhere.

accordion.title: Is Sleet suitable for small businesses?
accordion.content: Yes. Whether you manage a handful of vehicles or a large enterprise fleet, Sleet scales with your business and provides the tools needed to optimize logistics operations efficiently.

accordion.title: Can I customize the platform for my business?
accordion.content: Yes. Sleet offers customizable dashboards, reports, workflows, user roles, and integrations to match your operational requirements.

accordion.title: Does Sleet offer mobile applications?
accordion.content: Yes. Sleet includes mobile applications for drivers, fleet managers, and administrators, enabling seamless communication, trip updates, delivery tracking, and operational management on the go.

accordion.title: What industries does Sleet serve?
accordion.content: Sleet supports a wide range of industries, including Logistics & Transportation, Freight & Distribution, Manufacturing, Retail & E-commerce, Construction, Oil & Gas, Cold Chain Logistics, Government Fleets, and Enterprise Fleet Operations.

accordion.title: Can Sleet reduce operational costs?
accordion.content: Yes. By automating workflows, optimizing routes, improving fleet utilization, reducing fuel consumption, and providing AI-powered insights, Sleet helps businesses lower operational costs and improve overall efficiency.

accordion.title: How do I get started with Sleet?
accordion.content: Getting started is simple. Contact our team to schedule a personalized demo, discuss your business requirements, and choose the Sleet solution that best fits your operations. Our onboarding specialists will help you every step of the way.

accordion.title: Why choose Sleet over other logistics platforms?
accordion.content: Sleet brings everything together in one intelligent ecosystem. Instead of juggling multiple systems, you get fleet management, cloud-based logistics software, AI-powered reporting, and an on-demand truck marketplace, all connected through a single platform. This means less complexity, greater visibility, faster decision-making, and a smarter way to manage logistics.

dashcam.metaDescription: Watch live dashcam video from your trucks in Saudi Arabia, next to each vehicle's GPS position, speed and ignition status, in one fleet monitoring dashboard.
dashcam.cardText: Watch live camera streams from any vehicle, beside its location and status.
dashcam.title: Fleet Dashcam Live Video
dashcam.heading: See what your drivers see, live
intro: Sleet streams live video from the cameras in your vehicles straight to the Monitor page. Pick a vehicle, choose a camera channel, and watch the road or the cabin in real time, without calling the driver.
The video sits beside the vehicle's live position, speed and ignition status, so you see what is happening and where at the same moment.
dashcam.screenshot: Monitor page with a live dashcam stream open
dashcam.challengesTitle: Tracking a dot on a map only tells you half the story

challenges.title: Calls instead of facts
challenges.text: When something goes wrong on the road, the only source is a phone call to the driver.

challenges.title: Disputes you can't settle
challenges.text: Without a view of the road, incident and delivery disputes come down to one word against another.

challenges.title: Separate camera and tracking apps
challenges.text: Video in one system and GPS in another means switching screens to understand a single event.

faq.title: Which cameras are supported?
faq.content: Sleet works with dashcam trackers that connect through our tracking server. Contact us with your device model and we'll confirm compatibility.

faq.title: Can I watch more than one camera?
faq.content: Yes. If the device has several channels, you can switch between them in the player.

faq.title: Does live video use a lot of mobile data?
faq.content: Video is only streamed while someone is watching, and the stream stops when you close it, so data is used on demand rather than all day.

temperature.metaDescription: Monitor the temperature of refrigerated trucks in real time with Sleet. See each vehicle's live reading beside its location, speed and ignition status.
temperature.cardText: Live temperature readings from refrigerated vehicles, beside location and speed.
temperature.title: Truck Temperature Monitoring
temperature.heading: Know the temperature of every load, live
intro: For chilled and frozen goods, the temperature inside the truck matters as much as where the truck is. Sleet reads the temperature sensor connected to the vehicle's tracking device and shows it live in the Monitor page.
Dispatchers see the reading together with location, speed and ignition, so a warm truck is noticed while there is still time to act.
temperature.screenshot: Monitor page showing a vehicle's live temperature reading
temperature.challengesTitle: A failed cooling unit shouldn't be discovered by your customer

challenges.title: Problems found at the door
challenges.text: A cooling failure is often noticed only when the customer rejects the delivery.

challenges.title: No evidence for the customer
challenges.text: Without readings from the journey, you can't show that goods stayed within range.

challenges.title: Drivers reporting by phone
challenges.text: Manual checks are slow, easy to skip and impossible to verify.

temperature.capabilitiesTitle: Temperature, location and status in one view

capabilities.title: Live temperature per vehicle
capabilities.text: The current reading appears on each vehicle in the Monitor page.

capabilities.title: Location and temperature together
capabilities.text: See where the truck is, whether the engine is on, and how cold the load is, in one panel.

capabilities.title: Recorded with every position
capabilities.text: Each position update from the vehicle carries its sensor readings, building a trail for the journey.

capabilities.title: Uses your tracking device
capabilities.text: Temperature comes from a sensor wired to the same GPS tracker, with no separate system to manage.

capabilities.title: Built for delivery operations
capabilities.text: Combine temperature with routes, time slots and proof of delivery for chilled last-mile work.

faq.title: Which sensors work with Sleet?
faq.content: Sensors that connect to supported GPS trackers and report temperature with the vehicle's position. Send us your device model to confirm.

faq.title: Can I see temperature and location together?
faq.content: Yes. The Monitor page shows temperature beside speed, ignition, fuel and odometer for the selected vehicle.

faq.title: Is this suitable for food and pharma transport?
faq.content: It gives you live visibility of load temperature. Ask us about your specific compliance requirements before relying on it for regulated goods.

fuel.metaDescription: Track fuel across your fleet with Sleet: live fuel readings from vehicle sensors, fuel expense records per vehicle, and cost analytics to spot waste early.
fuel.cardText: Live fuel readings plus fuel cost records and analytics per vehicle.
fuel.title: Fleet Fuel Monitoring
fuel.heading: See where your fuel budget goes
intro: Fuel is usually the largest running cost of a fleet and the hardest to check. Sleet brings together the fuel level reported by the vehicle's sensor and the fuel expenses your team records, vehicle by vehicle.
With both in one place, unusual consumption stands out, and monthly fuel cost stops being a single unexplained number.
fuel.screenshot: Expense analytics showing fuel cost by vehicle
fuel.challengesTitle: Fuel is your biggest cost and your least visible one

challenges.title: Receipts in a drawer
challenges.text: Fuel spending is recorded late, on paper, or not at all.

challenges.title: No link between fuel and distance
challenges.text: Without odometer and fuel data together, you can't tell an efficient vehicle from a wasteful one.

challenges.title: Losses noticed too late
challenges.text: Leaks, misuse and theft only show up at the end of the month.

faq.title: Can I export fuel costs?

proofOfDelivery.metaTitle: Proof of Delivery Software with QR & Signatures
proofOfDelivery.metaDescription: Capture proof of delivery with Sleet: QR-coded boxes, pickup and delivery signatures, notes for partial or cancelled orders, and a full status history.
proofOfDelivery.cardText: QR-coded boxes, driver-captured signatures and a status history for every order.
proofOfDelivery.title: Proof of Delivery
proofOfDelivery.heading: Every box scanned, every delivery signed
intro: Sleet records each step of a delivery, from the warehouse to the customer's door. Boxes carry QR codes, drivers collect signatures at pickup and at drop-off, and every status change is stored with its time.
When a customer asks what happened to an order, the answer is on screen: who delivered it, when, and who signed for it.
proofOfDelivery.screenshot: Delivery detail with signatures and status history

challenges.title: Paper that goes missing
challenges.text: Signed delivery notes get lost, arrive days later, and can't be searched.

challenges.title: "We never received it"
challenges.text: Without a signature and a timestamp, disputed deliveries cost you the goods and the customer.

challenges.title: No view of partial deliveries
challenges.text: Returns and short deliveries are settled by phone and memory.

capabilities.title: QR code per box

capabilities.title: Pickup and delivery signatures

capabilities.title: Partial, returned and cancelled orders

capabilities.title: Status history

capabilities.title: Driver mobile app
capabilities.text: Drivers start their route, mark arrival and complete deliveries from their phone.

capabilities.title: Delivery reports
capabilities.text: List and summary reports show completed, cancelled and on-time deliveries.

faq.title: Do customers need an app to sign?
faq.content: No. The signature is captured on the driver's phone at the door.

faq.title: What happens with a partial delivery?
faq.content: The driver records it as partial with a note, and the order keeps a count of returns.

faq.title: Can I upload orders in bulk?
faq.content: Yes. Orders are uploaded from a sheet and assigned to routes and drivers.

documentExpiry.metaDescription: Never miss a renewal: Sleet tracks vehicle registration (istimara) and insurance dates plus driver ID and licence expiry, and flags them 60 days ahead.
documentExpiry.cardText: Registration, insurance, ID and licence dates flagged before they expire.
documentExpiry.title: Document Expiry Alerts
documentExpiry.heading: No vehicle off the road over a missed renewal
intro: An expired registration or insurance policy can take a vehicle off the road and bring fines. Sleet keeps the expiry dates for every vehicle and driver and shows which documents have expired and which are due within the next 60 days.
Your team gets a notification in the dashboard when a vehicle's document expires, with a link straight to that vehicle.

challenges.title: Found out at a checkpoint

challenges.title: Nobody owns the list

capabilities.title: Operating card and service dates

faq.content: Vehicle registration and insurance, and driver ID or iqama and driving licence. Operating card and service dates are stored on the vehicle record.

faq.title: How far ahead does it warn?
faq.content: Documents due within the next 60 days are listed as Expiring Soon.

faq.title: Can I import my vehicles?
faq.content: Yes. Vehicles can be added one by one or uploaded in bulk.

wasl.metaDescription: Connect your fleet to Wasl through Sleet: register your company, vehicles and drivers, and send live vehicle locations to the Transport General Authority platform.
wasl.cardText: Register vehicles and drivers with Wasl and report live locations automatically.
wasl.title: Wasl Integration
wasl.heading: Stay compliant with Wasl without extra work
intro: Licensed transport companies in Saudi Arabia must report their vehicles' live locations to Wasl, the Transport General Authority's tracking platform. Sleet does this for you from the same dashboard you already use to run your fleet.
Your company, vehicles and drivers are registered with Wasl once, and every position your trackers send is forwarded automatically.
wasl.screenshot: Fleet list with Wasl registration status per vehicle
wasl.challengesTitle: Compliance shouldn't need a second tracking system

challenges.title: Two systems for one fleet
challenges.text: A separate provider just for Wasl means double the devices, logins and cost.

challenges.title: Rejected registrations
challenges.text: A wrong plate letter or sequence number is rejected, and finding out why takes days.

challenges.title: Silent gaps
challenges.text: If locations stop reaching Wasl, you usually learn about it from a violation.

wasl.capabilitiesTitle: Wasl reporting built into your fleet dashboard

capabilities.title: Company registration
capabilities.text: Register your operating company with Wasl from your Sleet settings.

capabilities.title: Vehicle registration
capabilities.text: Send each vehicle's plate, sequence number and tracker IMEI to Wasl.

capabilities.title: Driver registration

capabilities.title: Automatic location reporting
capabilities.text: Every position from your trackers is forwarded to Wasl with speed and vehicle status.

capabilities.title: Status you can see
capabilities.text: Each vehicle and driver shows whether it is registered, pending or rejected, with the reason.

capabilities.title: Retry on failure
capabilities.text: Failed sends are retried automatically, so a brief outage doesn't leave a gap.

wasl.screenshot2: Wasl settings with company registration details

faq.title: Who needs Wasl?
faq.content: Transport companies licensed by the Transport General Authority, including goods transport and other regulated activities.

faq.title: What happens if a registration is rejected?
faq.content: The vehicle or driver is marked as rejected with the reason Wasl returned, so you can correct the details and retry.

Upload the day's orders, let Sleet group them into optimised routes for your drivers, and follow every box until it is signed for.

challenges.title: "Where is my order?"
challenges.text: Customer service has no answer without calling the driver.

challenges.title: Late deliveries nobody measures
challenges.text: Without on-time figures, the same delays repeat every week.

ecommerce.capabilitiesTitle: The daily delivery cycle, in one system

capabilities.title: Bulk order upload
capabilities.text: Upload orders from a sheet with customer, invoice, box size and time slot.

capabilities.title: Optimised routes
capabilities.text: Orders are grouped into routes and sequenced for each driver.

capabilities.title: Morning and evening slots
capabilities.text: Plan deliveries into time slots that match when customers are available.

capabilities.title: QR-coded boxes
capabilities.text: Each box gets a QR code, so the right items reach the right door.

capabilities.title: Proof of delivery
capabilities.text: Signatures at pickup and drop-off, with notes for partial or cancelled orders.

capabilities.title: Delivery performance
capabilities.text: Track on-time rate, average delivery time, successful delivery rate and driver performance.

steps: Add your warehouses, customers and drivers.
Upload each day's orders and let Sleet build the routes.
Follow deliveries live and review the day's performance.
ecommerce.screenshot2: Live Tracking map with drivers on their routes

faq.title: Can I use my existing order sheet?
faq.content: Orders are uploaded from a sheet. We'll share the template so your export matches it.

faq.title: Do drivers need special hardware?
faq.content: No. Drivers use the Sleet app on their phone.

faq.title: Can I deliver chilled goods?
faq.content: Yes. With a temperature sensor on the vehicle, you can watch the load temperature live.

transport.metaTitle: Fleet Management Software for Transport Companies
transport.metaDescription: Fleet management for Saudi transport companies: live GPS and dashcam monitoring, fuel and expense control, document expiry tracking and driver performance.
transport.cardText: Live monitoring, cost control and document tracking for multi-vehicle fleets.
transport.title: Transport & Fleet Companies
transport.heading: Run every vehicle from one screen
intro: When you operate more than a handful of vehicles, the questions pile up: where is each truck, which ones are idle, what is each costing, and whose documents are about to expire. Sleet answers them in one dashboard.
It is built for companies that own or rent their vehicles and want to see the whole fleet, not just a map.
transport.screenshot: Monitor page with the whole fleet on the map
transport.challengesTitle: A bigger fleet needs more than a tracking app

challenges.title: Tracking without context
challenges.text: A map shows where a vehicle is, not what it costs or whether it is legal to drive.

challenges.title: Costs spread across files
challenges.text: Fuel, maintenance and other expenses live in different places, per vehicle, per month.

challenges.title: Everyone sees everything
challenges.text: Without roles, either the whole team has full access or the manager does it all.

capabilities.title: Live fleet monitoring
capabilities.text: Position, speed, ignition, odometer, fuel and temperature for every vehicle.

capabilities.title: Dashcam video
capabilities.text: Open a live camera stream from any equipped vehicle.

capabilities.title: Expenses and receipts
capabilities.text: Record expenses against each vehicle, review them and download reports.

capabilities.title: Document expiry
capabilities.text: See expired and soon-to-expire registration, insurance, IDs and licences.

capabilities.title: Owned and rented vehicles
capabilities.text: Keep owned, rental and other vehicles in one list, with status and activity logs.

capabilities.title: Roles and permissions
capabilities.text: Give each employee access to only what their job needs.

steps: Add your vehicles and drivers, one by one or in bulk.
Assign a tracking device to each vehicle.
Invite your team with the right roles and start monitoring.
transport.screenshot2: Fleet list with status and logs

faq.title: How many vehicles can Sleet handle?
faq.content: Sleet works for small fleets and scales as you add vehicles. Tell us your fleet size and we'll walk you through it.

faq.title: Can I use my existing trackers?
faq.content: Often, yes. Send us the device model and we'll confirm whether it can connect.

faq.title: Can each branch or team have its own access?
faq.content: Yes. Roles and permissions control what each employee can see and do.
